about: The introitus of the formulary “5th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Hear, O Lord, my voice with which I have cried to You; be my helper, do not forsake me, and do not despise me, O God my Savior. The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Hear, O Lord, my voice with which I have cried to You; be my helper, do not forsake me, and do not despise me, O God my Savior.
